items.source: Construct a new AbstractTestNGSpringContextTests instance and initialize the internal TestContextManager for the current test class.
items.translation: 构建一个新的AbstractTestNGSpringContextTests实例，并为当前测试类初始化内部的TestContextManager。

items.source: Delegates to the configured TestContextManager to call 'after test class' callbacks.
items.translation: 委托给配置的 TestContextManager 以调用 '测试类后' 回调。

items.source: Delegates to the configured TestContextManager to post-process the test method after the actual test has executed.
items.translation: 委托给配置的 TestContextManager，在测试方法实际执行后对其进行后处理。

items.source: Delegates to the configured TestContextManager to call 'before test class' callbacks.
items.translation: 委托给配置的 TestContextManager 以调用 'before test class' 回调。

items.source: Delegates to the configured TestContextManager to pre-process the test method before the actual test is executed.
items.translation: 委托给配置的 TestContextManager，在测试方法实际执行之前对其进行预处理。

items.source: Delegates to the configured TestContextManager to prepare this test instance prior to execution of any individual tests, for example for injecting dependencies, etc.
items.translation: 委托给已配置的 TestContextManager，在执行任何单个测试之前准备此测试实例，例如用于注入依赖项等。

items.source: Exception - if a registered TestExecutionListener throws an exception
items.translation: Exception - 如果注册的 TestExecutionListener 抛出异常

items.source: Exception - allows all exceptions to propagate
items.translation: Exception - 允许所有异常传播。

items.source: Concrete subclasses should typically declare a class-level @ContextConfiguration annotation to configure the application context resource locations or component classes. Concrete subclasses must also have constructors which either implicitly or explicitly delegate to super();.
items.translation: 具体子类通常应声明一个类级别的@ContextConfiguration注解，以配置应用上下文的资源位置或组件类。具体子类还必须具有构造函数，这些构造函数要么隐式地，要么显式地将调用委托给super();。

items.source: The ApplicationContext that was injected into this test instance via setApplicationContext(ApplicationContext).
items.translation: 通过setApplicationContext(ApplicationContext)注入到此测试实例中的ApplicationContext。

items.source: Set the ApplicationContext to be used by this test instance, provided via ApplicationContextAware semantics.
items.translation: 设置此测试实例使用的ApplicationContext，由通过ApplicationContextAware语义提供。

items.source: Delegates to the test method in the supplied callback to execute the actual test and then tracks the exception thrown during test execution, if any.
items.translation: 委托到提供的 `<code>callback` 中的测试方法以执行实际测试，然后跟踪测试执行期间抛出的任何异常。

items.source: Logger available to subclasses.
items.translation: 可供子类使用的 Logger。

items.source: run in interface org.testng.IHookable
items.translation: run 在接口 org.testng.IHookable 中

items.source: testMethod - the test method which is about to be executed
items.translation: testMethod - 即将执行的测试方法

items.source: setApplicationContext in interface ApplicationContextAware
items.translation: `setApplicationContext` 在接口 `ApplicationContextAware` 中。

items.source: applicationContext - the ApplicationContext that this test runs in
items.translation: applicationContext - 此测试运行的 ApplicationContext

items.source: testMethod - the test method which has just been executed on the test instance
items.translation: testMethod - 刚刚在测试实例上执行的测试方法
